create_deterministic_distribution: create a Deterministic distribution with a given loc and optional atol and rtol tolerance parameters
sample_deterministic_distribution: sample n values from a Deterministic distribution which always returns the loc value
compute_prob_deterministic: compute the probability of a value being within slack tolerance of the loc using prob method
compute_kl_divergence_deterministic: compute the KL divergence between two Deterministic distributions using the registered TFP KL function
index_deterministic_distribution: index into a batched Deterministic distribution using getitem to extract a subset of parameters
